        let s : { x // ¬p x } := ⟨i, h⟩
        pH.2 s
  , left_inv := by
      intro f
      ext i
      dsimp
      split_ifs
      rfl
  , right_inv := by
      intro pH
      ext
      ext s
      dsimp
      split_ifs
      rfl
      ext s
      dsimp
      split_ifs
      rfl
  }
